building: 國立宜蘭大學農林修養室／修養室
scope: Low-detail exterior approximation of the one-storey main building after the 2016 restoration. Existence and selected facade details cross-checked against an official 2026 photograph. Not a 1934 reconstruction or a 2026 measured survey.
source_images_policy: Original photographs and PDF page images were downloaded to a private reference area and visually inspected. They are not redistributed in the public package and are not used as textures. Public records contain source URLs, adopted features and limitations only; citation does not grant redistribution rights.

sources.title: 國立宜蘭大學百年校史系列叢書 II：校園變遷
adopted_features: Large left oblique photograph: main hipped tile roof, visible facade and photographed left end, projecting entry and relative depth
Entry has its own lower gable roof and circular gable vent
Hexagonal window on photographed left side wall of the entry, grouped arched windows and rectangular wood-framed windows
Lower-right 2017 unveiling photograph corroborates restored front appearance
limitations: Perspective and occlusion prevent reliable metric measurement
Rear and complete end-wall arrangements are not shown
Text mentions a northeast corner cut, but its exact location and dimensions remain unresolved and the local cut is not carved in this candidate

adopted_features: Restored front facade and main tile roof
Central projecting entry with separate gable and circular vent
Large rectangular wood-framed windows and outer narrow arched windows
limitations: The first four historical photographs on the source page are excluded from the restored-era geometry
People and ceremony banners obscure parts of the lower facade
Front view does not establish building depth

adopted_features: Separate entry gable, circular vent and surrounding restored facade openings
limitations: Crowd and banner obscure entry and lower wall details
No reliable depth measurement can be obtained from this front photograph

adopted_features: Circular entry vent, large rectangular wood-framed windows and photographed right pair of arched windows
limitations: Temporary event canopy obscures the main roof and cannot establish its ridge or complete pitch
Canopy, people, signs and event equipment are excluded from the model

sources.publisher: 文化部文化資產局國家文化資產網
adopted_features: Location at 神農路一段1號
Brick load-bearing walls, timber roof structure and hipped tile roof
limitations: No restoration drawings or official metric dimensions were obtained
This identity is not the off-campus 民權日式眷舍, former principal residence or 宜蘭文學館

modeling_rules: Main roof is hipped; the lower projecting entry has a separate gabled roof
Use directly evidenced openings; do not invent complete symmetric arrangements across unseen facades
Hexagonal window is included on the photographed left entry wall only and is not mirrored
Unseen rear and right-end openings are omitted
Northeast corner cut remains unlocated and undimensioned; rectangular envelope is only a simplification
No unknown annexes, canopy, people, vegetation or neighbouring buildings
